svg.title: WiSARD pipeline: from real-valued features to a class score
svg.desc: A four-stage pipeline showing how WiSARD processes tabular data: real-valued features are thermometer-encoded into bits, the bits are routed into RAM-sized tuples by a random mapping, each RAM looks up the counter at its address pattern, and the counters are summed to produce a class score for one discriminator.
svg.text: Step 2. Binarize each value with t = 3 thermometer bits
Step 3. Route bits into a-bit tuples, one per RAM
a = 4 bits per tuple; number of RAMs R = ⌈n · t / a⌉ = ⌈4 · 3 / 4⌉ = 3
Step 4. Look up each tuple as a RAM address; counters give scores
